arxiv-1906-05612.title: Antonym-Synonym Classification Based on New Sub-space Embeddings
arxiv-1906-05612.creator: Muhammad Asif Ali, Yifang Sun, Xiaoling Zhou, Wei Wang, Xiang Zhao
arxiv-1906-05612.description: Abstract Distinguishing antonyms from synonyms is a key challenge for many NLP applications focused on the lexical-semantic relation extraction. Existing solutions relying on large-scale corpora yield low performance because of huge contextual overlap of antonym and synonym pairs. We propose a novel approach entirely based on pre-trained embeddings.

arxiv-2101-03568.title: A work fluctuation theorem for a Brownian particle in a non confining potential
arxiv-2101-03568.creator: Christoph Streißnig, Holger Kantz
arxiv-2101-03568.description: Abstract Using the Feynman-Kac formula, a work fluctuation theorem for a Brownian particle in a non confining potential, e.g., a potential well with finite depth, is derived. The theorem yields an inequality that puts a lower bound on the average work needed to change the potential in time.

arxiv-2109-01243.title: Discovery of a Highly Collimated Flow from the High-Mass Protostar ISOSS J23053+5953 SMM2
arxiv-2109-01243.creator: Tatiana M. Rodríguez, Peter Hofner, Esteban D. Araya, Qizhou Zhang, Hendrik Linz, Stan Kurtz, Laura Gomez, Carlos Carrasco-González, Viviana Rosero
arxiv-2109-01243.description: Abstract We present Very Large Array C, X, and Q-band continuum observations, as well as 1.3 1.3\, mm continuum and CO(2-1) observations with the Submillimeter Array toward the high-mass protostellar candidate ISOSS J23053+5953 SMM2. Compact cm continuum emission was detected near the center of the SMM2 core with a spectral index of 0.24 ( ± 0.15 ) \,(\pm 0.

arxiv-2303-10641.title: Spatial-sign based High Dimensional White Noises Test
arxiv-2303-10641.creator: Ping Zhao, Dachuan Chen, Zhaojun Wang
arxiv-2303-10641.description: Abstract A spatial-sign based test procedure is proposed for high dimensional white noise test in this paper. We establish the limit null distribution and give the asymptotical relative efficient of our test with respect to the test proposed by Feng et al. 2022 under some special alternative hypothesis.

arxiv-2308-02106.title: Radiatively-cooled quantum microwave amplifiers
arxiv-2308-02106.creator: Mingrui Xu, Yufeng Wu, Wei Dai, Hong X. Tang
arxiv-2308-02106.description: Abstract Superconducting microwave amplifiers are essential for sensitive signal readout in superconducting quantum processors. Typically based on Josephson Junctions, these amplifiers require operation at milli-Kelvin temperatures to achieve quantum-limited performance. Here we demonstrate a quantum microwave amplifier that employs radiative cooling to operate at elevated temperatures.

arxiv-2408-00482.title: Extending the field of view in modulation-based X-ray phase microtomography
arxiv-2408-00482.creator: Dominik John *, Junan Chen *, Christoph Gaßner, Sara Savatović, Lisa Marie Petzold, Sami Wirtensohn, Mirko Riedel, Jörg U. Hammel, Julian Moosmann, Felix Beckmann, Matthias Wieczorek, Julia Herzen
arxiv-2408-00482.description: Abstract Recent advances in propagation-based phase-contrast imaging, such as hierarchical imaging, have enabled the visualization of internal structures in large biological specimens and material samples. However, modulation-based techniques, which provide quantitative electron density information, face challenges when imaging larger objects due to stringent beam stability requirements and detector distortions.

arxiv-2501-15361.title: Decentralized Low-Rank Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
arxiv-2501-15361.creator: Sajjad Ghiasvand Mahnoosh Alizadeh Ramtin Pedarsani, Electrical, Computer Engineering Department, UC Santa Barbara
arxiv-2501-15361.description: Abstract While parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) techniques like Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) offer computationally efficient adaptations of Large Language Models (LLMs), their practical deployment often assumes centralized data and training environments. However, real-world scenarios frequently involve distributed, privacy-sensitive datasets that require decentralized solutions. Federated learning (FL) addresses data privacy by coordinating model updates across clients without sharing raw data.

arxiv-2502-07321.title: The Weinberg no-go theorem for cosmological constant and nonlocal gravity
arxiv-2502-07321.creator: Salvatore Capozziello, Anupam Mazumdar, Giuseppe Meluccio
arxiv-2502-07321.description: Abstract We show how a nonlocal gravitational interaction can circumvent the Weinberg no-go theorem on cosmological constant, which forbids the existence of any solution to the cosmological constant problem within the context of local field theories unless some fine-tuning is assumed.

arxiv-2504-14925.title: Super Moiré Domain Tessellations, Sliding Ferroelectricity, and Reconfigurable Quantum Dot Arrays in Twisted Trilayer Hexagonal Boron Nitride
arxiv-2504-14925.creator: Kunihiro Yananose, Changwon Park, Young-Woo Son
arxiv-2504-14925.description: Abstract At very small twist angles, bilayer moiré systems exhibit characteristic stacking domain patterns, where the moiré length scale is determined solely by the twist angle. In contrast, the additional stacking and twisting degrees of freedom in twisted trilayer systems give rise to richer and more intricate domain tessellations.

arxiv-2505-10623.title: Flat band mediated photon-photon interactions in 2D waveguide QED networks
arxiv-2505-10623.creator: Matija Tečer, Giuseppe Calajó, Marco Di Liberto
arxiv-2505-10623.description: Abstract We investigate a Lieb lattice of quantum emitters coupled to a two-dimensional waveguide network and demonstrate that this system supports an energetically isolated flat band, enabling localization despite the presence of long-range photon-mediated couplings. We then explore the two-excitation dynamics in both the softcore and hardcore interaction regimes, which arise from the nonlinearity of the emitters.

arxiv-2508-01233.title: Detailed radial scale height profile of dust grains as probed by dust self-scattering in HL Tau
arxiv-2508-01233.creator: Haifeng Yang (杨海峰), Ian W. Stephens, Zhe-Yu Daniel Lin, Manuel Fernández-López, Zhi-Yun Li, Leslie W. Looney, Rachel Harrison
arxiv-2508-01233.description: Abstract The vertical settling of dust grains in a circumstellar disk, characterized by their scale height, is a pivotal process in the formation of planets. This study offers in-depth analysis and modeling of the radial scale height profile of dust grains in the HL Tau system, leveraging high-resolution polarization observations.

pmc-10559995.description: In female mammals, the development and regulation of the reproductive system and non-reproductive system are significantly influenced by estrogens (oestrogens). In addition, lipid metabolism is another physiological role of estrogens. Estrogens act through different types of receptors to introduce signals to the target cell by affecting many estrogen response elements. Breast cancer is considered mostly a hormone-dependent disease.

pmc-11647453.title: Bismuth-based nanoparticles and nanocomposites: synthesis and applications
pmc-11647453.creator: Sujit Kumar, M. Premkumar, Jayant Giri, S. M. Mozammil Hasnain, Rustem Zairov, Jundao Wu, Zeai Huang
pmc-11647453.description: In the vast landscape of materials science, bismuth emerges as a compelling element with unique properties and diverse applications. Its intriguing characteristics and advancements in nanotechnology have propelled bismuth-based nanoparticles to the forefront of scientific exploration, promising breakthroughs in various disciplines.

However, whether the treatment of hearing loss influences engagement in physical activity remains unknown. Using data from the Aging Cognitive Health Evaluation in Elders (ACHIEVE) study, a 1:1 randomized control trial of a hearing care intervention (including the provision of hearing aids) compared to a health education control group, we investigated the effect hearing care vs.

pmc-12417264.title: Effectiveness of Medical Nutrition Therapy in the Management of Patients with Obesity and Endometriosis: from the Mediterranean Diet To the Ketogenic Diet, Through Supplementation. The Role of the Nutritionist in Clinical Management
pmc-12417264.creator: Luigi Barrea, Ludovica Verde, Giuseppe Annunziata, Peter Chedraui, Felice Petraglia, Gabriela Cucalón, Elisabetta Camajani, Massimiliano Caprio, Stefania Gorini, Giuseppe Gabriele Iorio, Raffaella Di Girolamo, Luigi Carbone, Sebastian Chapela, Evelyn Frias-Toral, Giovanna Muscogiuri
pmc-12417264.description: Purpose of the ReviewThis review aimed to summarize current evidence on the effectiveness of medical nutrition therapy (MNT) in the management of obesity and endometriosis, with a focus on dietary patterns such as the Mediterranean and Ketogenic diets, as well as nutritional supplementation.

pmc-12427821.title: Lasso Peptides—A New Weapon Against Superbugs
pmc-12427821.creator: Piotr Mucha, Jarosław Ruczyński, Katarzyna Prochera, Piotr Rekowski, Hah Young Yoo, Jin Cheol Yoo
pmc-12427821.description: The emergence of multi-drug-resistant bacteria (known as superbugs) represents one of the greatest challenges for human health and modern medicine. Due to their remarkable ability to rapidly develop resistance to currently used antibiotics, new molecular targets for bacteria and substances capable of effectively combating related infections are still being sought.

pmc-12505570.title: The two sub-genomes of the allotetraploid frog Xenopus laevis are evolving under similar selective pressure in extant populations
pmc-12505570.creator: Dareen Almojil, Vinu Manikandan, Nizar Drou, John Measey, Stéphane Boissinot
pmc-12505570.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The model species Xenopus laevis is an allotetraploid species, whose genome consists of two sub-genomes (the L and S sub-genomes) that were inherited from its parental species. Previous studies comparing the genome of X. laevis with other species of the genus revealed that the L sub-genome was more conserved than the S sub-genome suggesting it has been evolving under stronger purifying selection. However, it remains unclear if this difference reflects evolutionary processes that are still at play in extant populations.

pmc-12796903.title: 肥胖与阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停合并高血压的风险关联性研究
pmc-12796903.creator: 昕 赵, 茂莎 舒, 小英 李, 丽娟 彭, 晓晴 张
pmc-12796903.description: 目的探讨肥胖对阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（obstructive sleep apnea, OSA）合并高血压的影响及风险关联，明确不同肥胖评估指标〔体质量指数（body mass index, BMI）、颈围（neck circumference, NC）、腰围（waist circumference, WC）、体脂率（body fat percentage, BF%）、内脏脂肪指数（visceral adiposity index, VAI）〕在OSA人群高血压风险预测中的价值，为西南地区OSA患者高血压风险分层提供区域化证据。方法纳入2024年四川大学华西第四医院睡眠医学中心299例 OSA患者，按高血压诊断分为单纯OSA组（179例）和OSA合并高血压组（120例）。采用logistic回归分析肥胖指标与OSA合并高血压的风险关联，受试者工作特征（receiver operating characteristic, ROC）曲线评估各指标的预测效能，并结合年龄分层（≤45岁/>45岁）分析风险差异。结果两组（OSA合并高血压组 vs. 单纯OSA组）在年龄（中老年占比，65.0% vs. 38.5%）、文化程度（高中及以下占比，37.5% vs. 22.9%）、高血压家族史（60.0% vs. 33.0%）方面差异有统计学意义（P<0.01）。所有肥胖指标与OSA合并高血压均有风险关联，且随指标等级升高风险递增；VAI风险梯度最明显：≥P75者风险为<P25者的45.96倍〔比值比（odds ratio, OR）=45.96，95%置信区间（confidence interval, CI）：15.46～136.59〕，P50～P75者风险为<P25者的8.06倍（OR=8.06，95%CI：2.86～22.73）。VAI 预测效能最佳〔曲线下面积（area under the curve, AUC）=0.856，95%CI：0.819～0.893〕，优于传统指标（AUCBMI=0.821，95%CI：0.782～0.860；AUCWC=0.799，95%CI：0.760～0.838）；中老年组各肥胖指标对应的高血压风险均高于青年组。结论肥胖是OSA合并高血压人群的关键风险因素，VAI在OSA合并高血压风险预测中表现最优，可以作为该区域OSA患者高血压筛查的优先指标；年龄与肥胖指标存在风险叠加效应，中老年OSA人群需加强肥胖管理。 阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（obstructive sleep apnea, OSA）是以上气道反复塌陷导致间歇性低氧、睡眠结构紊乱为特征的睡眠呼吸疾病，中国成人OSA患病率达12.8%，患病人数超1.7亿[1]。高血压作为OSA最常见的心血管并发症，在OSA人群中合并率高达50%，而高血压患者中约30%合并OSA[2]，OSA与高血压共同存在时，其医疗支出比单纯OSA患者更高[3]，已成为成人健康的重要威胁。 肥胖是OSA与高血压共病的核心协同因素，但现有研究存在两点局限：一是多聚焦于体质量指数（body mass index, BMI）、颈围（neck circumference, NC）等传统指标，对反映内脏脂肪功能的内脏脂肪指数（visceral adiposity index, VAI）研究较少；二是未系统分析年龄与肥胖指标的交互作用，无法明确中老年OSA人群的风险特点。既往研究显示，西安地区BMI≥24 kg/m2的OSA患者高血压风险增加1.

pmc-12851554.title: Radiation-Induced Lumbosacral Radiculopathy: A Comprehensive Clinical and Dosimetric Study
pmc-12851554.creator: Zineb Dahbi, Reyzane El Mjabber, Amal Bouziyane, Nawal Bouknani, Wissam Bezzari, Rim Alami, Vincent Vinh-Hung, Aboubacar H Bambara
pmc-12851554.description: Background: Radiation-induced lumbosacral radiculopathy is an under-reported late complication of pelvic radiotherapy and may result in persistent neurological symptoms with a substantial impact on long-term quality of life. The primary objective of this study was to evaluate the association between radiation dose distribution to the lumbosacral plexus (LSP) and the occurrence of radiation-induced lumbosacral plexopathy (RILP).

pmc-13079661.title: High neutrophil-to-albumin ratio signals severe prognosis in LVO stroke—data from an EICU cohort
pmc-13079661.creator: Chao Yang, Jingying Wang, Yiyao Lu, Yinghe Xu, Yongpo Jiang, Hui Zhao
pmc-13079661.description: ObjectiveTo investigate whether the neutrophil-to-albumin ratio (NPAR) predicts adverse outcomes in acute large vessel occlusion (LVO) stroke.MethodsThis cohort study enrolled 893 LVO stroke patients (2021–2023). Associations between NPAR and outcomes were assessed using logistic regression, restricted cubic spline, and ROC analysis.ResultsHigher NPAR correlated with elevated NIHSS, inflammatory markers, coagulation parameters, and dysphagia, and decreased hemoglobin, lymphocytes, and GCS.

pmc-13277409.title: 2025 Korean Guidelines for Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation: Part 2. Current status of cardiac arrest and the chain of survival
pmc-13277409.creator: Sung Oh Hwang, Kyoung-Chul Cha, Woo Jin Jung, Young-Il Roh, Gyo Jin Ahn, Do Kyun Kim, Tae-Youn Kim, Youdong Sohn, Gyuhong Shim, Young Hwa Jung, Yunhee Oh, Chun Song Youn, Mi Jin Lee, Jisook Lee, Chang Hee Lee, Youngbin Jang, Yong Soo Jang, Gyu Chong Cho, Ju Sun Heo, Sung Phil Chung
pmc-13277409.description: In Korea, more than 30,000 out-of-hospital cardiac arrests (OHCAs) occur each year, and the survival rate remains below 10%. Because OHCA is difficult to predict and typically occurs outside medical facilities, effective management requires not only healthcare professionals but also laypersons, including bystanders and first responders.

pmc-13556799.title: 450. Do D2 partial agonists work in post-traumatic stress disorder? An effect size-driven meta-analysis
pmc-13556799.creator: M Ng, M P So, KY-C Chan, S Ng
pmc-13556799.description: BackgroundVery few psychopharmacological treatments (PPhTs) have ever been approved for post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). Recently, results from a few large randomized controlled trials (RCTs) investigating the combination of brexpiprazole and sertraline for PTSD have been detailed. One rationale for including brexpiprazole in the primary combination is its potent antagonism at α1-adrenergic receptors.

pmc-13608937.title: Arrayed Micropillar Ionic Film Iontronic Flexible Pressure Sensor and Its Wearable Sensing Applications
pmc-13608937.creator: Wenzhen Liang, Xiaodong Huang
pmc-13608937.description: Flexible pressure sensors serve as core sensing components for wearable health monitoring systems, electronic skins for soft robots, and flexible human–machine interaction devices. Benefiting from the interfacial electric double-layer polarization effect, iontronic sensing delivers far higher pressure response sensitivity than conventional parallel-plate capacitive sensors, endowing it with distinctive advantages in the detection of weak physiological signals.
